ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic distribution diagram of island-related information, and the legend marks symbols such as cities, rivers, mountain peaks, roads, railways, and national parks. Observing the locations of the city symbols, they appear more often in the coastal area on the right side of the island and the inland area on the right side, while there are relatively fewer on the left side. Then reason: Judging by ordinary map directions, the top is north and the right is east. Comparing the city symbols on the east and west sides of the island, the cities on the right side, namely the east side, are obviously more numerous and more concentrated, so the cities of this island are mainly distributed in the east.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是某岛屿示意图，图例标出城市、河流、公路、铁路、国家公园等符号，城市符号多出现在岛屿右侧沿海及右侧内陆一带。再推理：按地图方向，上方为北、右方为东；将城市符号按岛屿左右两半比较，右侧/东侧明显更多、更集中，因此该岛城市主要分布在东部。
method.CoT_raw:
